full_judgment: 3.The only point now being canvassed by Mr. B. K. Das, learned Advocate for the petitioner is that the petitioner having been added as a party-defendant on 29-5-88 the suit is barred against him under section 22 (1) of the Limitation Act and both the Courts erred in law in decreeing the suit against him.
